title: Single-cell RNA and BCR sequencing of age-associated B cells in mouse and human lupus
summary: To characterize age-associated B cells (ABCs), we performed single-cell RNA and BCR sequencing on splenic B-lineage cells from a murine lupus model induced by Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) stimulation and on peripheral blood B-lineage cells from a treatment-naïve patient with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).
